column4: Pick 1 of 3 starting tide relics (20 s; intro moved to the death screen)
Cold open: shipwreck ambush at tide 8 - first Crest inside 60 s
Fight: tide-pool crabs push the gauge (enemy tide intent introduced)
Event: Riptide shrine - trade HP for a Surge relic
Elite: Barnacle Knight (armored unless the tide is low)
Act 2 fight: reef sharks (enemies now Ebb the gauge against you)
Spring-tide night: opt in - next 2 fights start at tide 8 for double gold
Siren pair: the deck comes online - first double Crest
Elite: Undertow Twins (one Surges and one Ebbs every turn)
Act 2 boss: Storm Kraken (seizes the gauge every 2nd turn)
Elite: Twin Moray (optional path; skip = safer route)
Phase 2: the Moon-Eater swings the tide each turn - Crest on its turn to break it
